note: AXIS 1 of the collapse study (capacity). g_k/Δ_in/regret across LoRA rank on all 3 transferability levels (pile_of_law high, beancounter mid, enwik9 low). This is a RE-RUN of the earlier gk_enwik 3-dataset 10MB sweep now that eval_online records the regret-vs-base term (curr.bits_base) too — so gk_curve draws the cumulative-regret drift curve (enwik9 r128 crosses 0 = online worse than static, the −1.73% aggregate). Established: delta_pct is an inverted-U per dataset (optimal rank moves with transferability: enwik9 r16, beancounter r64, pile_of_law r32-64); the high-rank penalty is ordered by transferability (enwik9 goes NEGATIVE). Read per (dataset,rank): harmful%, mean g_k, transfer efficiency (g_k/Δ_in falls with rank), and now the regret drift. 10MB keeps the drift/crossover visible (a small-data artifact at 2MB). train_interval=1 -> per-chunk. Pairs with gk_lr + gk_epochs for the cross-knob COLLAPSE plot (g_k/outcome vs measured Δ_in, coloured by knob). lora_alpha unset -> alpha=2*r.
